title: Tensor Program Optimization for RISC-V Vector Extension using MetaSchedule probabilistic framework
problem: Optimizing tensor programs for RISC-V vector extensions requires careful scheduling and loop transformations to exploit hardware parallelism. Hand-tuned optimizations are labor-intensive and may not generalize across different vector configurations.
motivation: Automated scheduling with probabilistic search can discover effective loop transformation and memory access patterns tailored to RISC-V vector capabilities.
method: Uses the MetaSchedule probabilistic framework to automatically search the scheduling space of tensor programs, applying loop tiling, vectorization, and memory optimization strategies optimized for RISC-V vector extensions.
key_novelty: Application of MetaSchedule probabilistic scheduling to RISC-V vector extension, automating tensor program optimization.
contributions: MetaSchedule-based automated optimization for RISC-V vector programs
Generalized scheduling strategies for vector tensor operations
limitations: Performance gains may vary significantly across different tensor shapes and RISC-V vector configurations, potentially limiting applicability to specialized hardware variants.
